chapter: Trent's band: Texas, St. Louis and the road east
title: The Savoy week and heading for the Plantation
summary: A week at the Savoy and the poor pay Savoy bands received; John Fielding is still with them on to Cleveland.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: YEAH, WE WILL MAKE ANOTHER ONE. THE WEATHER WILL BE NICER TOO. LET'S SEE, OKAY SO, NOW WHEN YOU PLAYED THE SAVOY, HOW LONG WERE YOU AT THE SAVOY.
We were there at the Savoy for a week.
DID YOU PLAY THE LAFAYETTE THEATRE ALSO?
WHO WERE YOU PLAYING AGAINST. WAS IT CHICK'S BAND?
You know it wasn't Fats, because he was in Chicago. THE REGAL THEATER.

Right. We had seen Fats in Chicago. When we went there on our vacation. Fats was still in Chicago when we went into the Savoy. I don't remember who it was. IT COULD HAVE BEEN A LOT OF DIFFERENT BANDS.

But I do know that every time he sees me today, he talks about that Trent band. HE WOULD HAVE LOVED TO HAVE HAD THAT BAND IN THERE, BUT HE DIDN'T PAY ANY MONEY. FIFTY BUCKS A WEEK WAS THE HIGHEST HE EVER PAID ANYBOD.
I don't remember what it was, but according to what we YOU PROBABLY GOT GOOD MONEY COMPARED TO WHAT THE OTHER BANDS HAD BEEN GETTING. THEY DIDN'T PAY REGULAR BANDS.
Well BEDFORD (inaudible) HE WOULDN'T STAY. BECAUSE THEY WEREN'T PAYING ANY MONEY.
SO YOU GO OVER TO CLEVELAND. NOW THE PLANTATION, TRENT MUST HAVE GOTTEN YOU THE JOB AT THE PLANTATION, OR YOUR FRIEND SPARK. WASN'T JOHN FIELDING DOING SOMETHING. WAS HE TRAVELING WITH THE BAND TOO.
John was still with the band. HE'S STILL PLAYING WITH THE BAND. WHAT KIND STYLE DOES HE HAVE?
